parts.answer: The intersection of the closed unit disc centred at $-1+i$ with the half-plane on the required side of the ray from $1$ at argument $3\pi/4$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Show a circle with centre $-1+i$ - B1; need some indication of scale or a correct label, which may be marks on the axes. Show a circle of radius 1 with centre not at the origin, or the relevant part - B1. Show the correct half-line from 1, or the relevant part - B1. Shade the correct region on a correct diagram - B1. Guidance: with very different axis scales, the diagram must match that scale and the circle should be an ellipse; allow freehand diagrams with clear correct intention. Total: 4.
